executive_summary:
Tenaga presents mixed operating evidence: H1 operating profit increased slightly and net current liabilities improved, but Q2 operating margin contracted and owners earnings fell. The identified FX swing qualifies the net-profit comparison without erasing operating-margin pressure. Separate borrowing and lease obligations require a regulated-return cash bridge. Maintain observation; the evidence does not yet establish a directional new-position advantage.

Price is below both major averages after negative 20- and 60-bar returns, while RSI remains weak. Positive MACD histogram and a modest five-bar rebound soften the bearish view but lack volume confirmation and have not repaired the trend. Tenaga has a plausible investment-driven electricity demand tailwind, with fuel and regulated-return mechanisms limiting a direct macro profit conclusion. No unverified tariff or data-center catalyst is incorporated. The bear carries the current-entry caution because Q2 operating-margin pressure persists independently of the identified FX swing and funding returns remain unverified. Neutral recognizes slightly higher H1 operating profit and improved current liabilities rather than declaring uniform deterioration. Neither demand growth nor FX normalisation proves regulated shareholder cash value.
bull_case: Tenaga has slightly higher H1 operating profit and improved net current liabilities. Round two identifies the FX swing as a reason not to equate lower owners earnings with uniform operating deterioration, while retaining regulated cash returns and funding as required checks. Strongest disconfirming evidence to caution: H1 operating profit increased to RM4.539bn from RM4.439bn, net current liabilities improved materially, and the identified FX swing means the earnings decline is not a clean measure of operating deterioration.
bear_case: Owners earnings and Q2 operating margin fell, and substantial borrowings and separate leases require funding reconciliation. Round two accepts the FX qualification but notes it does not explain away margin compression or establish post-investment FCF.
key_uncertainties: Complete operating-to-owner earnings bridge and tariff/AFA reconciliation.
Latest FCF and separate borrowing/lease service capacity.
Post-investment FCF, lease and borrowing service capacity.
Matched valuation; scanned issuer statements were visually inspected but cash and tariff reconciliation remains incomplete.
Vendor financial statements lack verified fiscal/availability timing; vendor forward P/E is an estimate, and a matched normalised fair-value model is unavailable.
catalysts_upcoming: Next comparable issuer disclosure, date unavailable here: A comparable subsequent quarter restores operating margin to at least the observed prior-year 12.58% and a regulated-return cash bridge shows post-investment/debt/lease cash surplus above zero, resolving the principal entry objections.
Reassessment trigger rather than a forecast: A subsequent comparable H1 operating profit below RM4.439bn would invalidate the retained operating-resilience counterweight.
